description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在介紹室內設計中常用的構造和材料，以及它們在設計實踐中的應用。通過理論講解和實際案例分析，學生將瞭解不同材料的性質、優缺點，以及在室內設計中的選用原則。課程內容包括常見材料的性質與應用、材料選擇原則、材料之間的相互作用等相關主題，旨在為學生提供專業知識和技能，加強其在室內設計領域的實踐能力。
description.describe_eh: Introduce the common structures and materials used in interior design, as well as their applications in design practice. Through theoretical lectures and practical case analyses, students will understand the properties, advantages, and disadvantages of different materials, as well as the principles of selection in interior design. The course content includes the properties and applications of common materials, principles of material selection, interactions between materials, and other related topics. The goal is to provide students with professional knowledge and skills to enhance their practical abilities in the field of interior design.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解不同室內設計材料的特性和應用場景。
targets.describe_en: Understand the characteristics and application scenarios of different interior design materials.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握常見建築材料的性質、特點和選用原則。
targets.describe_en: Master the properties, characteristics, and selection principles of common building materials.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠根據設計需求合理選擇材料，並將其應用於實際設計項目中。
targets.describe_en: choose materials reasonably according to design requirements and apply them to actual design projects.

targets.describe_ch: 理解材料選擇對設計風格、功能性和美感的影響，並能夠做出適切的設計決策。
targets.describe_en: Understand the impact of material selection on design style, functionality, and aesthetics, and be able to make appropriate design decisions.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生的實踐能力和創意思維，提升其在室內設計領域的設計水平。
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students’ practical abilities and creative thinking, and enhance their design level in the field of interior design
